**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject bound SDK zombies before declaring consumers clear**

When an already-bound SDK ADB appears as a zombie in the supplied process snapshot, the candidate filter skips it before this new `bound_detail` path is reached, and `consumer_guard` also excludes zombies from `other`. The PID is therefore treated as clear without the required fresh full snapshot proving absence, allowing closure and restoration even though the V07 contract explicitly rejects a PID that remains present, including as a zombie. Handle the bound zombie before filtering candidates or make it a hard failure.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject endpoints that reappear before the final lstat**

If a Bee endpoint disappears during the FD probes but is recreated before this final `lstat`, `disappeared` has already forced `after=None`; the successful final lookup is only recorded and the caller still returns `bee-socket-absent`. That leaves a currently present replacement without any fresh ownership binding, and a last resource sample can consequently succeed while representing the live socket as absent. Treat a successful final lookup after an observed ENOENT as a reappearance that requires rebinding or an incomplete observation.
